+"""Tests for string authors value handling in stage_literature_batch.
+
+Tests ensure that when 'authors' is a single string, it is kept whole
+rather than being split into characters.
+"""
+
+from runtime.literature_staging import stage_literature_batch
+
+
+def test_string_authors_kept_whole():
+    """A string authors value becomes a one-element tuple of the stripped string."""
+    result = stage_literature_batch(
+        [
+            {
+                "source_record_id": "paper-1",
+                "title": "Test Paper",
+                "authors": "Smith J, Doe A",
+                "taxon_name": "Test Species",
+            }
+        ],
+        source="test",
+        canonical_lookup={"Test Species": "taxon:test-species"},
+    )
+    assert len(result.staged) == 1
+    assert result.staged[0].authors == ("Smith J, Doe A",)
+
+
+def test_blank_string_authors_gives_empty_tuple():
+    """A blank string authors value (or whitespace only) gives an empty tuple."""
+    result = stage_literature_batch(
+        [
+            {
+                "source_record_id": "paper-1",
+                "title": "Test Paper",
+                "authors": " ",
+                "taxon_name": "Test Species",
+            }
+        ],
+        source="test",
+        canonical_lookup={"Test Species": "taxon:test-species"},
+    )
+    assert len(result.staged) == 1
+    assert result.staged[0].authors == ()
+
+
+def test_list_authors_keeps_non_empty_entries():
+    """A list of authors keeps non-empty entries in order."""
+    result = stage_literature_batch(
+        [
+            {
+                "source_record_id": "paper-1",
+                "title": "Test Paper",
+                "authors": ["Smith J", "", "Doe A"],
+                "taxon_name": "Test Species",
+            }
+        ],
+        source="test",
+        canonical_lookup={"Test Species": "taxon:test-species"},
+    )
+    assert len(result.staged) == 1
+    assert result.staged[0].authors == ("Smith J", "Doe A")
+
+
+def test_string_authors_with_whitespace_stripped():
+    """A string authors value with leading/trailing whitespace is stripped."""
+    result = stage_literature_batch(
+        [
+            {
+                "source_record_id": "paper-1",
+                "title": "Test Paper",
+                "authors": "  Smith J, Doe A  ",
+                "taxon_name": "Test Species",
+            }
+        ],
+        source="test",
+        canonical_lookup={"Test Species": "taxon:test-species"},
+    )
+    assert len(result.staged) == 1
+    assert result.staged[0].authors == ("Smith J, Doe A",)
+
+
+def test_list_authors_with_whitespace_stripped():
+    """List entries with whitespace are stripped."""
+    result = stage_literature_batch(
+        [
+            {
+                "source_record_id": "paper-1",
+                "title": "Test Paper",
+                "authors": ["  Smith J  ", "", "  Doe A  "],
+                "taxon_name": "Test Species",
+            }
+        ],

+        canonical_lookup={"Test Species": "taxon:test-species"},
+    )
+    assert len(result.staged) == 1
+    assert result.staged[0].authors == ("Smith J", "Doe A")
+
+
+def test_missing_authors_gives_empty_tuple():

task.body:
## Problem
`stage_literature_batch` (`runtime/literature_staging.py`) iterates `record.get("authors")`. When `authors` is a single string, as in Europe PMC records elsewhere in this codebase, it is split into characters: `authors="Smith J, Doe A"` becomes `('S', 'm', 'i', 't', 'h', ' ', 'J', ',', ...)`.

## Required behaviour
- A string `authors` becomes a one-element tuple of the stripped string: `"Smith J, Doe A"` -> `("Smith J, Doe A",)`.
- A blank string gives `()`: `"   "` -> `()`.
- A list keeps its non-empty entries in order: `["Smith J", "", "Doe A"]` -> `("Smith J", "Doe A")`.
- Nothing else changes.

## Scope
Allowed paths:
- `runtime/literature_staging.py`
- `tests/test_literature_staging_authors.py`

Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above. `tests/test_literature_staging_authors.py` is a new file.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_literature_staging_authors.py tests/test_calyx_core_rebase_002a.py`
- `python -m ruff check runtime/literature_staging.py tests/test_literature_staging_authors.py`

New tests must cover:
- the three cases above.

OC-SWARM-CAPABILITY: open-ended-code-authoring
OC-SWARM-WRITES: literature, repo-global
